More inline preview formats, optional upload protection, and a per-share management link.

## Added

- **More inline preview formats.** The download page now previews **audio** (MP3, M4A/AAC, OGG, WAV, FLAC, Opus), **text & code** (rendered as escaped text, size-capped), and **SVG** (rendered safely via `<img>`), plus more **image** (BMP, ICO, APNG) and **video** (MOV, M4V) types — alongside the existing image/video/PDF. All decryption is client-side, rendered in inert elements, and reuses the already-decrypted bytes (no extra download is counted).
- **Optional upload protection.** Set `UPLOAD_PASSWORD` and only people who know it can create shares; download links stay open to everyone. Enforced server-side on both write paths (constant-time check, rejected before anything is stored). Unset = open, exactly as before.
- **Per-share management link.** Every new share now comes with a secret management link (`/m/<slug>#t=…`, shown next to the share link) that lets you delete the share before it expires. The server stores only a hash of the token, the token rides in the URL fragment, and existing shares are unaffected.

## Notes

- Zero-knowledge is unchanged throughout: the server never sees file contents, names, or the keys/tokens — only hashes.
- `UPLOAD_PASSWORD` can be set in the Unraid template (advanced) to lock uploads; use a value without leading/trailing spaces.
